title: Lead Protocol decisions entry (one JSONL line)
description: Canonical schema for a single decision entry in .agents/decisions.jsonl. The log format is JSON Lines (one object per line, no enclosing array). Append-only, immutable — never rewrite past lines. This schema describes one line; a valid file is a sequence of lines, each matching this schema.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Seconds required; timezone optional (defaults to local).

agent.description: Agent signature in square brackets — same format as handoff.last_agent. Human contributors use '[Human / <github-username>]' or '[Human / <name>]'.

decision.description: Short imperative sentence describing the decision. Not the action taken — the decision that led to the action.

rationale.description: Why this decision was made. Should be self-contained — a future agent reading this entry alone should understand the motivation without needing the surrounding conversation.

files_affected.description: Relative paths of files modified as a direct consequence of this decision. Empty array is valid for pure-process decisions that touched no files.

status.description: completed = decision executed and still current. in_progress = work underway. rolled_back = decision was reversed by a later decision (which should cite this entry's timestamp in its rationale). superseded = a later decision replaced this one (same rationale-citation expectation).

supersedes.description: Optional. Timestamp of a prior decision this one replaces. Used together with status='superseded' on the older entry when you append the replacement.
